bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = f6b8c36315a8bf8dfc5ff91fde3bd8be40ed5c89
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1)" = false
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import io,json,subprocess,tarfile,sys
raw=subprocess.check_output(["docker","cp","debug-ai-debug-ai-1:/app/runtime/durable/durable/run-state-v2","-"])
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
    states=[json.load(archive.extractfile(m))["payload"] for m in archive.getmembers() if m.isfile() and m.name.rsplit("/",1)[-1].startswith("run_") and m.name.endswith(".json")]
active=[s for s in states if s.get("job_status") in ("QUEUED","RUNNING","RETRY_WAIT","PAUSED")]
print(json.dumps([{k:s.get(k) for k in ("run_id","project_id","project_dir","job_status")} for s in active]),flush=True)
if active:
    sys.exit(79)
print("NO_RECOVERABLE_RUNS; STOPPED_APP; CLEAN_SOURCE",flush=True)
PY
